'''''Ischnolepis''''' is a species of plants in the family [[Apocynaceae]] first described as a genus in 1909.<ref name=s>[http://www.tropicos.org/Name/50179315 Tropicos, genus ''Ischnolepis'' ]</ref><ref>[https://www.biodiversitylibrary.org/page/14902607#page/69/mode/1up Jumelle, Henri Lucien & Perrier de la Bâthie, Joseph Marie Henry Alfred. 1909.  Revue Générale de Botanique 21: 52-53. ] description in Latin, discussion in French</ref><ref>Schatz, G. E., S. Andriambololonera, Andrianarivelo, M. W. Callmander, Faranirina, P. P. Lowry, P. B. Phillipson, Rabarimanarivo, J. I. Raharilala, Rajaonary, Rakotonirina, R. H. Ramananjanahary, B. Ramandimbisoa, A. Randrianasolo, N. Ravololomanana, Z.S. Rogers, C.M. Taylor & G. A. Wahlert. 2011. Catalogue of the Vascular Plants of Madagascar. Monographs in systematic botany from the Missouri Botanical Garden</ref><ref>Venter, H. J. T. & R. L. Verhoeven. 1997. A tribal classification of the Periplocoideae (Apocynaceae). Taxon 46: 705–720.</ref>

It contains two species:<ref name = powo/>
* ''[[Ischnolepis graminifolia]]'' {{small|(Costantin & Gallaud) Klack.}} – [[Madagascar]]
* ''[[Ischnolepis natalensis]]'' {{small|(Schltr.) Venter}} – South Africa
